# Hash-pinned requirement for the Actions job's `pip install --require-hashes`. zizmor declares
# no runtime dependencies (confirmed against PyPI's JSON API for this release), so this file pins
# only zizmor itself; every wheel pip could pick for a Linux GitHub Actions runner is listed so
# the install never fails on an architecture mismatch. Hashes are the sha256 digests PyPI's JSON
# API (https://pypi.org/pypi/zizmor/1.31.1/json) reports for each file; the first (manylinux
# x86_64) was cross-checked by downloading the file and hashing it locally.
#
# Bumping zizmor: update the version here and in ci.yml together, re-fetch each hash from PyPI's
# JSON API (or `pip download` + `pip hash`), and re-run both locally.
